title: Worst script ever
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")


local removeChance = 1.0 
local soundId = "rbxassetid://7318656825" 


local function getPlayerItems()
    local items = {}
    for _, item in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Tool") then
            table.insert(items, item)
        end
    end
    if character then
        for _, item in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
                table.insert(items, item)
            end
        end
    end
    return items
end


local function playSound()
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.SoundId = soundId
    sound.Volume = 0.5
    sound.Looped = false
    sound.Parent = character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    sound:Play()
    sound.Ended:Connect(function()
        sound:Destroy()
    end)
end


local function removeRandomItem()
    local items = getPlayerItems()
    if #items > 0 then
        local randomIndex = math.random(1, #items)
        local itemToRemove = items[randomIndex]
        itemToRemove:Destroy()
        playSound()
    end
end


spawn(function()
    while true do
        wait(1)
        if math.random() <= removeChance then
            removeRandomItem()
        end
    end
end)


player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    character = newCharacter
end)
